visual_action: A fast-paced montage shows Vice President Kamala Harris in various campaign settings. She is seen on stage with running mate Tim Walz, waving to large crowds at rallies. Other clips show her interacting warmly with supporters, including children and families. She also appears on stage with her husband Douglas Emhoff, former President Barack Obama, and former First Lady Michelle Obama. Other scenes include Harris speaking at podiums, deplaning Air Force Two, and wearing a "DETROIT VS EVERYBODY" t-shirt. Throughout the montage, there are shots of enthusiastic crowds, American flags, and campaign signs. The video ends with a shot of Harris waving as red, white, and blue confetti falls.

cast.name: Kamala Harris
cast.evidence: Kamala Harris is featured in every clip of the montage.

cast.name: Tim Walz
cast.evidence: Appears on stage waving next to Kamala Harris at the beginning of the video. A "HARRIS - WALZ" sign is also visible in the crowd in another shot.

cast.name: Michelle Obama
cast.evidence: Appears on stage waving alongside Kamala Harris.

cast.name: Barack Obama
cast.evidence: Appears on stage raising his and Kamala Harris's hands in the air.

cast.name: Douglas Emhoff
cast.evidence: Appears walking hand-in-hand with Kamala Harris.

on_screen_text.text: this is your sign to make a plan to vote 💙

spoken_summary: There is no speech or dialogue in the video; it is set entirely to music.
audio_music: An upbeat, high-energy pop song with female vocals plays throughout the video, creating an inspirational and motivational mood.
editing_pacing: The video is a fast-paced montage with quick cuts between various clips.
central_claim: The energy and excitement around Kamala Harris's campaign should serve as a sign for you to make a plan to vote.
intended_effect: To energize viewers, create a positive association with Kamala Harris, and motivate them to vote.
